age_limit.details: Junior Research Fellow: Maximum Age: 28 years. Age relaxation will be given as per Govt. of India norms.

qualification.details: Junior Research Fellow: B.S. 4 years programme / BPharm / MBBS / Integrated BS- MS / MS / MSc / BE / BTech or equivalent degree with 55% marks and passing of NET/GATE test in any branches of Life Sciences, with 2 years' experience in molecular biology techniques, cloning, transfection and transduction, and animal cell culture.

salary_details.details: Junior Research Fellow: ₹ 37,000/- + 16% HRA per month

selection_process: Applications should be submitted online. Shortlisting for the online selection interview based on eligibility criteria. Selection of suitable candidates will be made based on qualifications and performance in the selection interview.
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RGCB Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RGCB to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology (RGCB) for the CSIR-ASPIRE Project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in RGCB Notification 05/2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under a temporary engagement setup.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online for RGCB JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving completed online applications is 09 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.S. 4 years programme, BPharm, MBBS, Integrated BS-MS, MS, MSc, BE, BTech or equivalent degree with 55% marks along with a valid NET/GATE test.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any work experience required for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants are required to possess 2 years of experience in molecular biology techniques, cloning, transfection and transduction, and animal cell culture.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit for applying to the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 28 years, with age relaxations applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary/stipend offered for the selected Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of ₹ 37,000/- plus 16% HRA.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for RGCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment drive is strictly online through the official portal.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted based on eligibility criteria followed by performance in an online selection interview.
